description: Fetch one public URL and return machine-readable page metadata: HTTP status, title, meta/og description, canonical URL, language, link count and a short text sample. Honest 4xx/5xx statuses are returned as data, not as errors. Use it for link previews, source triage and citation checks. Paid per call via x402 (USDC on Base, no account, no API key). 【価格】0.00 USDC。【使い方】呼ぶと 402 と PAYMENT-REQUIRED（支払い条件）が返る。USDC で支払い、同じ引数に PAYMENT-SIGNATURE ヘッダを添えて再送すると結果が返る。

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of a public page

name: url-meta
